env.//: A dev client still auto-detects the LAN IP, so nothing is set here.

preview.//: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL here, pointing at staging, before building. It is deliberately absent rather than a placeholder: src/config.ts throws at startup when nothing is configured, and a placeholder domain would disarm that guard and produce an installable build that fails every request instead.

production.//: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL here before the first real build. Absent on purpose - see the note on the preview profile. A production build pointed at a domain nobody owns fails on a device you cannot reach, which is the exact failure the startup guard exists to prevent. autoIncrement is set because the Play Store rejects a re-used versionCode.
